raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some txn_ids were delivered more than once across ingest batches, most likely as replays or restatements: 4972 raw rows but only 4827 distinct txn_ids, and txn_ts has fewer distinct values than txn_id, which is consistent with duplicated copies. Silver takes every POSTED row without deduplicating, so it has duplicate keys and gold counts and totals are inflated. The fix keeps the latest delivered version of each txn_id, then applies the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
